name: Basil Fruit Salad with Strawberries, Peaches, Grapes & Whipped Cream

instructions.primary_message: Place a large bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
3 peaches
1 small pkg fresh basil
0.68 kg red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a medium bowl. Add sugar and stir to combine.
Trim and halve strawberries; add to the bowl with the lemon and sugar.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Add grapes to the bowl and stir to combine the fruit salad; set aside.
Remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream, sugar, and vanilla into the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp granulated sugar
¾ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
To serve, divide fruit salad between bowls and top with whipped cream. Enjoy!
